comparison.objective: Shave a manikin's cheek and jaw while stretching the skin and limiting pressure.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual skin tensioning, curved-surface tool tracking, and contact-force regulation.
comparison.success_condition: At least 95% beard coverage, no excessive force or protected-feature contact, shaver returned, released, and still.
comparison.reason: Tests compliant surface following and safety-critical force control, not rigid-body sifting.
